title: Rename an exported function
prompt: Rename the exported function `slugify` in slug.js to `toSlug`. Nothing about its behaviour changes.
check: node -e "import('./slug.js').then(m => { if (!m.toSlug) { console.error('toSlug is not exported'); process.exit(1) } if (m.slugify) { console.error('slugify is still exported'); process.exit(1) } })" && node index.js | grep -qx 'hello-world' && node --test
